claim: Patchline extracts a normalized query shape from heterogeneous data-access code so that ORM calls, raw SQL, prepared statements, and generated query-builder chains all reduce to the same (operation, table) representation the migration analysis can reason over. The worker applies a per-dialect extractor to each source string, recovering the operation and target table from raw SQL FROM/INTO/UPDATE clauses, from ORM model names, from prepared-statement SQL, and from query-builder table calls. The gate proves all four query styles yield the correct operation and table, that model names are normalized to table names, and that a non-query negative control yields no shape.
real_repo: synthetic-from-real patterns: ActiveRecord, raw SQL, db.prepare, Knex
